control: Timely response rate by bank and month
description: Share of closed complaints with Timely response = Yes. Bank-months with fewer than 30 closed complaints are skipped.

control: Complaints still in progress after 60 days
description: Age of each 'In progress' complaint, counted to the extract date. The 60 days comes from CFPB guidance.

control: Routing lag from CFPB to bank
description: Days between Date received and Date sent to company, checked per bank and month.

control: Sent to bank before it was received
description: Date sent earlier than date received.
Counted, not failed. Some consumers live abroad or leave the state blank.

control: Closed complaint with no timeliness flag
description: Every closed complaint should have Timely response filled.

control: Monthly volume spike by bank and product
description: Monthly count above the trailing 6-month mean plus 3 standard deviations. Series averaging under 10 a month are skipped.
